⇄ Move FC to another NGO
This moves the FC's own login, every beneficiary they created, and those beneficiaries' scheme/advocacy records to the new NGO. The FC keeps every beneficiary — nothing is reassigned to anyone else. Fully audit-logged, nothing deleted.
Reassign Beneficiary
—
Reassigning transfers ownership of this beneficiary's record. If the new coordinator is in a different NGO, the beneficiary's NGO tag updates too.
